newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian gold, silver prices fall on fresh imports.
newsitem.headline: Indian gold, silver prices fall on fresh imports.

text.p: Indian gold and silver prices fell in early trade on Monday on sluggish demand and fresh arrivals of the imported metals, dealers said.
On Monday gold was down by 30 rupees per 10 grammes and silver by 40 rupees per kg.
"Stockists remained active sellers following reports of a fresh setback in the world market," one broker said.
Despite the current wedding season demand, seasonal buyers kept away anticipating a further price erosion. Traders said the market may weaken later in the day.
Prices of a gold biscuit (116.50 grammes) fell by 100 rupees to 59,000 rupees. They were down by 350 rupees on Monday and by 650 rupees last week.
